subject.title: fix(gateway): isolate wizard exits from shared process

question: Should Gateway `wizard.start` permanently expose optional `installDaemon` so remote setup clients that already own service installation can preserve that ownership?
rationale: The lifecycle isolation is a bounded bug fix, but adding a field to the generated public Gateway request contract is a lasting product and compatibility choice that tests cannot make on behalf of protocol owners.

options.title: Accept the optional RPC field
options.body: Keep `installDaemon` optional and preserve omission semantics, giving managed clients an explicit way to avoid competing daemon installation.

options.title: Land lifecycle isolation only
options.body: Remove the new RPC field and retain the shared-process exit and cancellation fixes while deferring remote daemon-control policy to a separate approved protocol proposal.

recommendation.title: Accept the optional RPC field
recommendation.body: Keep `installDaemon` optional and preserve omission semantics, giving managed clients an explicit way to avoid competing daemon installation.

likelyOwner.reason: CassieMei authored the proposed Gateway and wizard ownership changes and is the strongest available implementation-history routing candidate.
